exp6394_gate_receipt.honest_verdict: complete_positive: family harnesses are frozen before held access; held licenses are not implied

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: The three mandated GGUF model rows come from cached SOTA helper calls.
field_principles.autotokenizer_usage_count: Bare zero proves no external tokenizer path was used.
field_principles.cached_sota_pair_receipts: Helper-call receipts prevent manual model substitution.
field_principles.capability_license_records: Accepted licenses bind model, harness, schema, tokenizer, family, manifest, and expiration.
field_principles.cuda_offload_and_runtime_receipts_by_mod: CUDA offload, timing, raw streams, and cleanup are reported per model.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time is measured without padding.
field_principles.embedded_gguf_tokenizer_receipts: Tokenizer receipts use only embedded GGUF tokenizers.
field_principles.exp6394_gate_receipt: The Exp6394 freeze gate and frozen sidecars are revalidated before held evaluation.
field_principles.field_principles: Every required field states its guard and scientific purpose.
field_principles.field_provenance: Every required field maps to specs, upstream artifacts, sidecars, model receipts, tests, or exact checks.
field_principles.frozen_harness_and_schema_hashes: Harness sidecars and canonical schema are hash-bound.
field_principles.harm_underpowered_missing_and_flagged_ce: Missing, underpowered, abstained, rejected, and attacked cells stay visible.
field_principles.held_factor_transport_license_ready_scor: Readiness is a conjunctive matrix gate and never a universal-support claim.
field_principles.held_manifest_path_hash_license_balance_: Held events are licensed, balanced, sealed, and not read before freeze.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict starts with a terminal prefix and states the license boundary.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate declares deterministic verifier replay over local GGUF identity receipts.
field_principles.license_binding_and_expiration_fields: License identity and expiry fields are explicit and narrow.
field_principles.licensed_cell_count: Bare count of valid model-family licenses.
field_principles.licensed_constraint_family_count: Bare count of families with at least one valid license.
field_principles.licensed_model_count: Bare count of mandated models with at least one valid license.
field_principles.model_family_harness_freeze_ready_score: The Exp6394 gate proves only that harnesses froze before held access.
field_principles.model_file_hashes_revisions_quantization: Model file identity and tokenizer method are pinned.
field_principles.model_row_family_label_harness_schema_so: Swap, drift, fallback, abstention, repetition, and promotion attacks fail closed.
field_principles.model_weight_change_count: Bare zero proves no model weights changed.
field_principles.models_used: Only mandated models with authenticated runtime receipts count as used.
field_principles.per_model_constraint_family_trial_transp: Every model-family cell reports transport, source binding, exact calls, abstention, timeout, latency, and cost.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Preconditions bind upstream, models, tokenizers, GPU, schema, manifests, sources, and protected files.
field_principles.preregistered_license_rule: The exact licensing thresholds are frozen before held outcomes are scored.
field_principles.prohibited_mechanism_usage_counts: Retry, repair, reselection, tuning, family substitution, fallback, and external-tokenizer counts stay zero.
field_principles.protected_leakage_count: Protected leakage must be zero for any license.
field_principles.random_seed: Fixed seeds pin held schedule and matrix order.
field_principles.raw_output_before_parse_paths_hashes_and: Raw bytes are frozen before one parse.
field_principles.rejected_and_abstained_cell_records: Every unlicensed cell has a terminal reason.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A normalized checksum detects artifact drift.
field_principles.status: Terminal status separates positive, null, blocked, and retired held-license evidence.
field_principles.tests_run: Verification commands and exit codes are recorded.
field_principles.universal_support_claimed: Bare false prevents a universal gate from reappearing under another name.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Bare true applies only to exact task checkers.

honest_verdict: complete_positive: narrow held factor transport licenses issued for qualified model-family cells only

exact_fail_promotion.reason: exact fails are never counted as false accepts

fallback_laundering.reason: fallback model ids are null in every cell

family_label_swap.reason: constraint family is bound to held event hashes

harness_drift.reason: sidecar hashes are revalidated before evaluation

model_row_swap.reason: model file hash and model id are bound in the license key

repeated_output.reason: repeated output cannot promote without source-bound exact calls

source_substitution.reason: source hash is checked before exact calls

stale_schema.reason: canonical schema hash is present in each license
